children: Gulf corporate sentiment rebounded in the second quarter despite continued disruption from the Iran war, investor-relations advisory firm Iridium Advisors says. Its GCC Earnings Call Sentiment Index rose 17% to 34.5 points across 150 calls held in July and August, the first increase since the conflict began. Management-presentation sentiment rose 15% to 45.7 points, above its long-term average, while analyst Q&A sentiment remained below its historical norm. Qatar posted the strongest country improvement at 45%, followed by Saudi Arabia at 27% and the U.A.E. at 9%. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)
